description: Agent infrastructure platform that provides managed authentication, tool execution, sessions, triggers, governance, and secure access to more than 1,500 apps.

evidence.finding: Composio lets organizations restrict agent capabilities with per-user, team, or role policies, including exact tool allowlists and read-only session controls.
Composio documents that access is bound to identity-provider accounts so deprovisioning a user revokes the agent's access, and its privacy policy allows deletion requests.
Composio states that every tool call is logged with the user, team, tool, action, outcome, and refused calls, giving reviewers a trace of agent activity.
Composio's documented approval flows can pause side-effecting or destructive tool calls and require explicit user confirmation before execution.
Composio offers a free tier with 100,000 tool calls, 50,000 triggers, unlimited connected accounts on customer-owned apps, and no credit card requirement.
Composio's privacy policy gives users rights to access, correct, delete, withdraw consent for, and receive a copy of their personal data.
Composio's compliance guidance says standard plans do not guarantee end-to-end zero retention or zero training across third-party providers, so those guarantees require enterprise terms.
Composio is model- and framework-agnostic, supports MCP and multiple SDKs, and says customers can switch agents without reconnecting their app integrations.
Composio publishes detailed usage prices, a hard-capped free tier, and spend caps on paid usage to reduce surprise billing.
Composio's enterprise controls include team-level permissions, SSO and SCIM, shared connections, and auditable actions tied to users and teams.
Composio supports explicit approval requirements for destructive and side-effecting tools, preserving human confirmation for consequential actions.
Composio provides a no-credit-card free tier, broad framework support, and managed authentication intended to lower the setup burden for developers building agents.

limitations: This preliminary audit uses public Composio primary-source documentation and has not been reviewed by Composio.
Published product documentation is evidence of documented controls and policies, not proof of real-world outcomes for every deployment.
Humanity Score is a product-impact rating, not a regulatory, legal, safety, compliance, or government certification.
correction_policy: Source-backed factual corrections are welcome. Corrections change the audit only when the underlying evidence changes; payment cannot buy a higher score.
